# rcodezero_zone (Resource)

A zone on the RcodeZero Anycast DNS network. Deleting it removes the zone from public DNS; consider lifecycle.prevent_destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Master zone: records are managed at RcodeZero.
resource "rcodezero_zone" "primary" {
  domain = "example.at"
  type   = "master"

  lifecycle {
    # Destroying the zone removes it from public DNS.
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Slave zone: RcodeZero transfers the zone from your primary nameservers.
resource "rcodezero_zone" "secondary" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  type    = "slave"
  masters = ["192.0.2.1", "2001:db8::1"]
}

output "nsset" {
  description = "Nameservers to delegate the zone to at the parent."
  value       = rcodezero_zone.primary.nsset
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Zone name in lower case without trailing dot, e.g. example.at. Changing it replaces the zone.
- `type` (String) master (records managed at RcodeZero) or slave (transferred from masters).

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Disabled zones stay configured but are not served in DNS. Master zones only.
- `masters` (Set of String) IP addresses of the primary nameservers. Required for slave zones, not allowed for master zones.
- `serial_auto_increment` (Boolean) Increment the serial on RRset updates. Master zones only, null for slave zones. If never set, the API default (true) applies; removing it from the config later keeps the current value.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Timestamp when the zone was added to RcodeZero, as returned by the API.
- `id` (String) Same as domain.
- `nsset` (List of String) Nameservers serving the zone, for delegation at the parent.
